requirements.statement: Freeze and byte-verify the complete externally accepted Stage 6 closure.
Preserve all frozen v1, accepted v2, and Stage 1 through 6 authorities.
Execute exact Python 3.11.13, Java 17, Spark 3.5.6, and Py4J 0.10.9.7.
Require equal clean driver and worker interpreters, ANSI mode, UTC, and local two-worker execution.
Recompute transaction deltas and absolute differences with decimal(38,0) Spark expressions.
Recompute all three settlement deltas and their maximum absolute difference in Spark.
Match local ordering, counts, reason precedence, statuses, source identities, and exact logical values.
Write and independently read typed transaction and settlement Parquet datasets.
Compare canonical logical projections rather than nondeterministic physical Parquet bytes.
Prove deterministic logical digests across independent clean runs and partition order.
Execute every one of the twenty-one frozen behavioral scenarios.
Exercise every one of the twenty-one closed reason codes with exact ownership and outcome.
Fail closed on unknown reasons, missing scenarios, or undocumented outcome substitutions.
Test matched, exception, late-data revision, policy revision, replay, conflict, crash, and concurrency critical paths.
Prove Spark partition and input-order invariance without changing authority semantics.
Retain deterministic Stage 6 authoritative replay behavior after Spark projection.
Do not call AWS, dispatch AWS workflows, mutate infrastructure, or claim managed persistence.
Do not change frozen schemas or reinterpret accepted financial and finalization contracts.
Keep Spark projection non-authoritative; authority remains exclusively with Stage 6 finalization.
Pass formatting, lint, strict typing, complete tests, and owned 100 percent statement and branch coverage.
Kill every registered Stage 7 semantic mutation with zero survivors.
Build and install a reproducible wheel in two independent exact clean environments.
Require exact-head draft pull-request CI and inspect immutable evidence before readiness.
Require manual squash merge and independent main CI before external Stage 7 promotion.
